name: villain
summary: C2 framework that can handle multiple TCP socket & HoaxShell-based reverse shells, enhance their functionality with additional features and share them among connected sibling servers.
highlights: -x — HoaxShell server port (default: 8080 via http, 443 via https).
-i — Allows any Villain client (sibling server) to connect to your instance without prompting y
-c — Path to your ssl certificate (for HoaxShell https server).
-k — Path to the private key for your certificate (for HoaxShell https server).
-q — Do not print the banner on startup.
